browser: Codex in-app Chromium browser on macOS
checks: Before implementation, Foundation starting preset control was absent.
Fresh load selects Chorus synth, Stillwater and Tape On; transport remains Start.
All 18 native preset choices select during live playback, retaining Stillwater and Tape On.
Selecting Velvet strings switches instrument and parameters; one Undo restores Stillwater chorus; Redo restores Velvet strings.
Focused preset shared rail advances Prism tide to Copper bells; Undo restores Prism tide.
Preset changes retain key G, Scene Stillwater and previously selected Tape Off.
Explicitly saved Estuary draft recovers Morph synth, prior key and Tape Off while remaining paused.
Stillwater Whole piece restores Chorus synth and Tape On.
No observed browser warning or error logs during live switching.
Existing private preview serves matching bundled app SHA256; real HTTPS page shows new defaults.
limitations: Tablet and Split View controls require scrolling inside the existing editor bay.
Muted live playback checks control/graph behavior, not subjective sound quality.
Viewport emulation does not establish physical-device touch or battery acceptance.
